In this video, Firstpost explains the backlash against Kendall Jenner for wearing an Om-printed sarong featuring sacred Hindu symbols. Indian social media users question the use of religious imagery as beachwear, reigniting debates over cultural appropriation and religious sensitivity. Gursshheen Gahllen brings you the details on Firstpost America.
